I fixed 12 rules in `pricebook.py` where the code didn't match the docstring:

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 02, 122 | The cap was applied to the amount before the percentage was taken | Compute the discount first, then cap it with `min(disc, cap)` |
| 38 | Discount was rounded with `round`, not floored | Changed to `// 100` so it rounds down to the won |
| 118 | The cap only kicked in when the discount was over 60,000 | Always cap with `min(disc, 30000)` |
| 06, 143 | Used `qty > 50` | `qty >= 50` |
| 31, 46 | Used `qty > 100` | `qty >= 100` |
| 40, 58 | Used `qty >= 11` | `qty >= 10` |
| 48, 139 | Used `qty >= 13` | `qty >= 12` |

To check, I ran all 150 rules against a reference built from each docstring and the module's shared rules. It covered quantities 0 to 129 plus 200, 500 and 1000, each at 9 unit prices. No rule's output differed from the reference.

STATUS: DONE
